I therefore retain a small exceptional-outcome probability but reduce the informed crowd estimate from 5.6% to 2.5%, rather than treating the national 33% preference figure as a local electoral forecast.

These considerations warrant a modest downward adjustment if the crowd gives the national 33% headline electoral significance. Neither item confirms Binface's participation or supplies local polling, and even a major breakthrough must land within the narrow 30–40% interval. Given the informed crowd anchor and those uncertainties, I reduce YES probability from 5.6% to 4%.
